basis: Inflammation directly affects the uvea; most forms are immune-mediated or infectious. Associated systemic diseases are separate conditions.
Congenital vertebral and epiphyseal dysplasia; myopia in 42/93 (~45%) and hearing impairment in 32/87 (~37%). Retinal detachment and cord compression are minority complications.
Cartilage-producing mesenchymal neoplasm, represented by osteochondroma, chondroblastoma and chondrosarcoma.
Primary tuberculosis infection of the skin; pulmonary disease is not intrinsic to this cutaneous concept.
Defined by reduced circulating neutrophils. Infection susceptibility does not establish an additional directly damaged organ or an autoimmune mechanism.
Blood dyscrasia, perinephric collections and pulmonary shunts define TEMPI; telangiectasia 100%, thrombosis 30-79%. CNS hemorrhage omitted by cap; autoimmune mechanism unproven.
CDSN-related hypotrichosis affects scalp hair; sparse scalp hair occurs in 34/34 patients.
Rare chromosomal syndrome associated with developmental delay/intellectual disability; supplied record does not establish common damage to additional organs.
Tick-transmitted relapsing bacterial infection. Fever, myalgia, rash and organ enlargement do not establish common lasting organ damage.
Adult GM2 storage disorder causes central and peripheral neurodegeneration. Weakness and dysphagia are neurogenic; direct muscle pathology is occasional.
Inherited reticulate pigment disorder; skin pigmentation abnormalities occur in 11/11. Broad glycosylation ancestry alone does not establish a clinical metabolic disorder in this subtype.
Glycosylation disorder with skin laxity and severe osteoporosis. Intellectual disability in 7/8 supports neurologic involvement despite the definition describing it as rare.
Defining anomalies affect the mandible, mouth opening and external ears. Cardiac and pulmonary maldevelopment are reported, but their frequency is not established here.
Muscular dystrophy, contractures and cardiac conduction or myocardial disease define Emery-Dreifuss dystrophy. Neurogenic and treatment-related complications are not inferred.
Acute myeloid malignancy of marrow and blood with multilineage dysplasia and cytopenias; common direct extramedullary damage is not established.
CITED2-related congenital ventricular septal defect directly affects cardiac structure.
Familial febrile seizure disorder, also designated a generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus subtype.
Inherited cone photoreceptor dysfunction causes reduced visual acuity and abnormal cone electroretinography; no extraocular disease is established.
Papillary urothelial neoplasm originates in the renal pelvis.
Benign fibroblastic neoplasm arises from the cranium and produces an osteolytic lesion; intracranial neurologic damage is not established.
Defining defects involve radial bones, diaphragm and abdominal wall with herniated abdominal viscera. Common intrinsic pulmonary damage is not established.
Inherited mitochondrial disorder defined by optic atrophy and neurologic degeneration. Constipation and dysphagia do not establish independent direct gastrointestinal damage.
Skeletal dysplasia and cleft palate define disease. Airway malacia/respiratory insufficiency occur in 80-99%; hearing loss in 3/5. Gonadal abnormalities omitted by cap.
Acquired deficiency of coagulation proteins. Liver disease and vitamin K deficiency are causes, not organs directly damaged by the factor deficiency; autoimmunity is subtype-specific.
Trauma-induced brain dysfunction, including post-traumatic cognitive impairment or dementia.
